name: QSC_PROD_GRP_MAP_INTENTS
description: This table is used to store the administrative data defining the mapping intent to drive mapping generation.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_MAP_INTENT_ID
columns.description: Product Group Map Intent Identifier. Primary Key.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ALGORITHM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Algorithm Type. To allow customization of map generation in future.

columns.name: MAP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Mapping Type Code.

columns.name: MAP_INTENT_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique Map Intent Reference Number

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of map generation.

columns.name: SRC_ROOT_ID
columns.description: Root product group identifier in source hierarchy.

columns.name: TRGT_ROOT_ID
columns.description: Root product group identifier in target hierarchy.

columns.name: LAST_STRUCT_CHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the last structural changes were published.

columns.name: LAST_DATA_POPULATE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the last time data was populated.

columns.name: FROM_DATE
columns.description: Date from which map should be generated.

columns.name: TO_DATE
columns.description: Date until which the map should be generated.

columns.name: BATCH_KEY
columns.description: Holds transient information about the batch process that is updating the map.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: MAP_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Used to detect when the underlying map row was last modified.

columns.name: MAP_SUBSTATUS_TEXT
columns.description: Internal column used to store more details on admin and async modules.
